comparison.objective: Depress a rail end stop while sliding a carriage off the rail; candidate fractures and collects HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated stop holding and constrained linear sliding versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, impact regulation, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage passes the held stop and leaves the rail versus four clean fractures and contained fragments without damage. Numeric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Its bimanual coordination serves release-and-slide removal, not impact-driven fracture.
